blocks.name: dashboard-overview
blocks.title: Dashboard Overview
blocks.description: A responsive product dashboard with metrics, an accessible trend chart and recent activity.
blocks.accessibility: Includes a labelled chart with an accessibility layer, a named activity table and a heading-led page hierarchy.

blocks.name: login-page
blocks.title: Login Page
blocks.description: A complete sign-in surface with native form semantics, password recovery and account access guidance.
blocks.accessibility: Uses native labelled inputs, autocomplete attributes, a submit button and visible recovery links.

blocks.name: settings-page
blocks.title: Settings Page
blocks.description: A responsive workspace settings form for identity, localization and notification preferences.
blocks.accessibility: Groups visible labels, descriptions and native form controls in a predictable keyboard order.

blocks.name: team-members
blocks.title: Team Members
blocks.description: A member management card with identity, role, status and explicit row actions.
blocks.accessibility: Every member action has a unique accessible name and status remains available as text.

charts.name: chart-recipes
charts.title: Chart Recipes
charts.description: Six token-aware and accessible Recharts recipes: Area, Bar, Line, Pie, Radar and Radial.
charts.accessibility: Every chart has an accessible name, Recharts accessibility layer and a concise text summary of the data.

components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
components.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that reveal content.
components.accessibility: Base UI connects headings, triggers and panels; Enter and Space toggle a panel while Tab follows normal document order.

components.name: alert
components.title: Alert
components.description: A static status message with optional title, icon and action.
components.accessibility: Choose role=status for advisory updates and role=alert only for urgent dynamic content; keep title, description and recovery action visible.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.title: Alert Dialog
components.description: A modal confirmation surface for important or destructive decisions.
components.accessibility: Always provide a title and description; Base UI traps focus and requires an explicit response.

components.name: aspect-ratio
components.title: Aspect Ratio
components.description: A layout primitive that preserves a fixed width-to-height ratio.
components.accessibility: The ratio wrapper is presentational; give the hosted image, media, figure or other content its own semantics and alternative text.

components.name: attachment
components.title: Attachment
components.description: A file attachment surface with media, metadata, actions and an optional trigger.
components.accessibility: Keep filename, file type, size and upload or error state available as text; give every icon-only action and trigger its own accessible name and tab stop.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
components.description: A user or entity image with fallback, badge and grouping support.
components.accessibility: Name informative people or entities, keep decorative avatars hidden, always include AvatarFallback and provide context for group overflow counts.

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
components.description: A compact label for status, category or metadata.
components.accessibility: Keep badges as text by default; use status semantics only for actual state and never rely on color alone.

components.name: breadcrumb
components.title: Breadcrumb
components.description: A hierarchical path that locates the current page within a structure.
components.accessibility: Use a named navigation landmark with an ordered list, real destination links, decorative separators and aria-current on exactly one current page.

components.name: bubble
components.title: Bubble
components.description: A conversational content surface with alignment and reaction support.
components.accessibility: When bubbles form a conversation, provide a named log, identify each speaker and preserve chronological DOM order.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: A primary action primitive with visual variants and sizes.
components.accessibility: Base UI preserves native button semantics, disabled state and keyboard activation.

components.name: button-group
components.title: Button Group
components.description: A visual and semantic grouping for closely related actions or controls.
components.accessibility: Name the group, preserve native tab order and use Toggle Group instead when the items represent pressed or mutually exclusive state.

components.name: calendar
components.title: Calendar
components.description: A date selection calendar with single, multiple and range modes.
components.accessibility: Provide a visible purpose and date format; React DayPicker manages the calendar grid and keyboard navigation.

components.name: card
components.title: Card
components.description: A compositional surface for grouped content and actions.
components.accessibility: Add region or article semantics only when the card is a meaningful standalone section and connect it to a heading at the correct level.

components.name: carousel
components.title: Carousel
components.description: A keyboard-operable sequence of slides powered by Embla Carousel.
components.accessibility: Name the carousel and every slide, provide Previous and Next as non-drag controls, and do not capture arrow keys from interactive slide content.

components.name: chart
components.title: Chart
components.description: Token-aware wrappers, tooltip and legend utilities for Recharts visualizations.
components.accessibility: Name the graphic, provide a concise text summary and exact values when the task requires them, and never rely on color alone to distinguish series.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.description: A binary or mixed-state selection control.
components.accessibility: Pair with FieldLabel; Base UI manages checked, indeterminate and disabled states.

components.name: collapsible
components.title: Collapsible
components.description: A trigger that reveals or hides a single region of related content.
components.accessibility: Base UI connects the trigger and panel with expanded and controlled-region state while preserving trigger focus.

components.name: combobox
components.title: Combobox
components.description: A searchable single or multiple selection input with listbox behavior.
components.accessibility: Use a visible label and name clear or remove actions; Base UI manages active options, selection, filtering and keyboard navigation.

components.name: command
components.title: Command
components.description: A searchable command list that can be embedded or opened in a dialog.
components.accessibility: Name the search input, keep items inside groups with stable values, and attach one observable onSelect action to every executable command.

components.name: context-menu
components.title: Context Menu
components.description: A contextual action menu opened from pointer or keyboard interaction.
components.accessibility: Base UI manages focus and menu navigation; every action must remain available without a pointing device.

components.name: data-table
components.title: Data Table
components.description: A reusable TanStack Table composition with sorting, filtering, pagination and selection support.
components.accessibility: Provide a table name or caption, associated headers, aria-sort, keyboard-operable filter and pagination controls, empty feedback and a live result count.

components.name: date-picker
components.title: Date Picker
components.description: A controlled or uncontrolled date selection composition built from Button, Calendar and Popover.
components.accessibility: Use a visible FieldLabel and named popup; the trigger restores focus, the calendar preserves DayPicker keyboard navigation and the hidden form value follows disabled state.

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog
components.description: A modal task surface with focus management and dismissal behavior.
components.accessibility: Always provide DialogTitle and DialogDescription; Base UI manages focus trapping and restoration.

components.name: direction
components.title: Direction
components.description: A provider for left-to-right and right-to-left component behavior.
components.accessibility: Keep direction aligned with the content language and DOM reading order; the provider must not reverse meaning or keyboard sequence.

components.name: drawer
components.title: Drawer
components.description: A swipeable edge panel with modal, nested and snap-point behavior.
components.accessibility: Always provide a title, description and explicit close path; swipe and snap points require equivalent non-drag controls, and the base stylesheet positions body for iOS Safari.

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.title: Dropdown Menu
components.description: An anchored menu for actions, selections and nested commands.
components.accessibility: Use menu items for actions rather than site navigation; Base UI manages roving focus and keyboard navigation.

components.name: empty
components.title: Empty
components.description: A structured empty state with media, explanation and an optional next action.
components.accessibility: Use a programmatic heading, concise description, decorative media and a named keyboard-operable recovery action.

components.name: field
components.title: Field
components.description: A semantic composition for labels, controls, descriptions and validation messages.
components.accessibility: Connect labels, descriptions and errors to the control with stable IDs and aria-describedby.

components.name: form
components.title: Form
components.description: A native form composition with Field-based body layout, pending state and responsive actions.
components.accessibility: Preserves native form submission and validation semantics; compose every control with a visible label and connected error text.

components.name: hover-card
components.title: Hover Card
components.description: A non-modal preview surface shown from hover or keyboard focus.
components.accessibility: Use a real destination link as the trigger, keep focus on that link and never hide essential information or actions only in the visual preview.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.description: A single-line text input built on the Base UI input primitive.
components.accessibility: Use inside Field with a visible label; provide autocomplete and inputMode where relevant.

components.name: input-group
components.title: Input Group
components.description: A text control composed with inline addons, actions or keyboard hints.
components.accessibility: Use InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea with a visible external label and named icon buttons; clicking a non-interactive addon focuses the contained control.

components.name: input-otp
components.title: Input OTP
components.description: A segmented one-time-password input backed by a single accessible value.
components.accessibility: Provide a visible label, autocomplete=one-time-code and clear validation text.

components.name: item
components.title: Item
components.description: A compositional row for media, title, description and related actions.
components.accessibility: Give standalone items an appropriate article, listitem or link semantic, connect title and description, and name every action; use Field for form controls.

components.name: kbd
components.title: Kbd
components.description: A compact representation of keyboard input or shortcuts.
components.accessibility: Use native kbd markup and pair keys with adjacent text that explains the command; do not make the keycap itself focusable.

components.name: label
components.title: Label
components.description: A visible label for form controls.
components.accessibility: Bind the visible label to exactly one labelable control with htmlFor and a matching id so pointer activation moves focus.

components.name: marker
components.title: Marker
components.description: A compact annotated line with optional icon, border or separators.
components.accessibility: Keep marker text meaningful without its icon or separator; hide decorative media and add status semantics only for real updates.

components.name: menubar
components.title: Menubar
components.description: A persistent horizontal set of menus for application commands.
components.accessibility: Use for application commands, place items inside MenubarGroup and connect every action; Base UI manages roving trigger and menu focus.

components.name: message
components.title: Message
components.description: A structured conversation message with content, metadata and actions.
components.accessibility: Expose each message as a named article when needed, keep sender, content and delivery state in accessible text and preserve chronological DOM order.

components.name: message-scroller
components.title: Message Scroller
components.description: A conversation viewport with managed anchoring and scroll-to-start or end controls.
components.accessibility: Name the scroll viewport and log, keep stable message IDs, announce new content intentionally, preserve reader position and transfer focus to the viewport after the scroll-to-end control disappears.

components.name: native-select
components.title: Native Select
components.description: A styled native select for simple options and platform-native behavior.
components.accessibility: Associate the select with a visible label and use optgroup for meaningful option groups.

components.name: navigation-menu
components.title: Navigation Menu
components.description: A responsive navigation structure with links and optional disclosure panels.
components.accessibility: Name the navigation landmark, use real links, mark the current route and keep disclosed destinations reachable by keyboard.

components.name: pagination
components.title: Pagination
components.description: A page navigation pattern with current, previous, next and overflow states.
components.accessibility: Provide unique native links, mark exactly one current page, localize the landmark and remove unavailable Previous or Next links from the tab order.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: A non-modal anchored surface for compact interactive content.
components.accessibility: Use a meaningful trigger and title or description when the content needs a named region.

components.name: progress
components.title: Progress
components.description: A determinate progress indicator with optional label and value.
components.accessibility: Provide an accessible label plus minimum, maximum and current values when determinate; omit the current value when indeterminate and do not add a tab stop.

components.name: questionnaire
components.title: Questionnaire
components.description: A multi-step question flow with navigation and progress state.
components.accessibility: The declared @shadcn/react flow owns step behavior; use semantic field groups and announce step changes, validation errors and progress.

components.name: radio-group
components.title: Radio Group
components.description: A mutually exclusive set of options.
components.accessibility: Wrap the group in FieldSet and FieldLegend; Base UI manages arrow-key navigation.

components.name: resizable
components.title: Resizable
components.description: A set of panels whose dimensions can be adjusted with a separator.
components.accessibility: Expose the separator orientation and current range, keep every drag adjustment keyboard operable and provide sensible minimum and maximum panel sizes.

components.name: scroll-area
components.title: Scroll Area
components.description: A styled scroll viewport that preserves native scrolling behavior.
components.accessibility: Preserve native scrolling; only add a viewport tab stop when keyboard scrolling is required and provide a contextual region name in that case.

components.name: select
components.title: Select
components.description: A single-selection popup control with groups and scrolling support.
components.accessibility: Base UI manages trigger, popup, active option and keyboard navigation relationships.

components.name: separator
components.title: Separator
components.description: A horizontal or vertical visual divider.
components.accessibility: Keep purely visual dividers decorative; expose separator semantics and orientation only when the divider communicates document structure.

components.name: sheet
components.title: Sheet
components.description: A modal panel that enters from an edge of the viewport.
components.accessibility: Always provide SheetTitle, SheetDescription and an explicit close path; content and actions must remain scroll-reachable at mobile widths and zoom.

components.name: sidebar
components.title: Sidebar
components.description: A responsive application sidebar with collapsible and mobile sheet behavior.
components.accessibility: Compose a named navigation landmark with real links, aria-current and the generated trigger relationship; keep a visible close path in the mobile Sheet.

components.name: skeleton
components.title: Skeleton
components.description: A non-interactive placeholder for content that is loading.
components.accessibility: Keep skeleton shapes hidden from assistive technology and mark the containing region busy with one meaningful loading label.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.description: A single or range value input along a horizontal or vertical track.
components.accessibility: Provide an accessible label and meaningful minimum, maximum and step values for every thumb.

components.name: sonner
components.title: Sonner
components.description: A lightweight toast renderer that follows the active UI Foundation theme.
components.accessibility: Choose polite or assertive announcements from urgency, never steal focus, name every action and keep essential information available in persistent content.

components.name: spinner
components.title: Spinner
components.description: A compact animated progress indicator for indeterminate work.
components.accessibility: Name standalone loading status, localize that label and hide the spinner when adjacent button or status text already communicates loading.

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch
components.description: An immediate on or off setting control.
components.accessibility: Pair with FieldLabel; Base UI exposes switch semantics and checked state.

components.name: table
components.title: Table
components.description: Semantic table primitives for structured rows, headers, captions and summaries.
components.accessibility: Provide a caption or associated name, use scoped header cells and native row order, and expose sorting only through actual controls and aria-sort.

components.name: tabs
components.title: Tabs
components.description: A set of panels where one section is visible at a time.
components.accessibility: Keep triggers inside TabsList; Base UI manages roles, selection and arrow-key navigation.

components.name: textarea
components.title: Textarea
components.description: A multi-line text input that grows with its content.
components.accessibility: Use inside Field with a visible label and describe limits or requirements before errors occur.

components.name: toast
components.title: Toast
components.description: A Base UI toast system with queueing, actions, swipe dismissal and a five-item visible limit.
components.accessibility: Choose the appropriate live-region urgency, never steal focus, pause dismissal during interaction, name every action and keep essential information persistent elsewhere.

components.name: toggle
components.title: Toggle
components.description: A two-state pressed control for formatting or view options.
components.accessibility: Provide a visible or equivalent accessible name, expose aria-pressed without relying on color and keep focus on the control after keyboard activation.

components.name: toggle-group
components.title: Toggle Group
components.description: A single or multiple selection group composed from toggle items.
components.accessibility: Provide a group and item names, unique array values and an explicit selection mode; visual orientation is forwarded to Base UI keyboard behavior.

components.name: tooltip
components.title: Tooltip
components.description: A short non-interactive explanation for a focused or hovered trigger.
components.accessibility: Do not place interactive content in a tooltip; wrap the application in TooltipProvider.

components.name: typography
components.title: Typography
components.description: A token-aware Typeset container for semantic HTML and rendered Markdown content.
components.accessibility: Preserve native document elements, logical heading order, meaningful links and readable lists; Typeset changes presentation, not semantics.
